password_change_note: Changing your password logs you out everywhere else.
password_too_long: Password must be at most 72 bytes.
delete_account_description: Your messages stay but show as “Deleted User”. Your profile, avatar and uploads are deleted, you leave every guild (guilds you own pass to their highest-ranked member) and your username becomes free.
delete_account_message: This can't be undone. Enter your password to delete {username} on {server}.
avatar_shrink_failed: Couldn't shrink that image enough; try a simpler one.
animated_avatar_note: GIFs and animated WebPs stay animated.
devices_intro: Everywhere you're logged in on this server. Log out anything you don't recognise.
logged_out_other_devices: Logged out of all other devices
browser_only_note: These settings apply to this browser only.
theme_own_look_note: Themes pick their own light or dark look.

colour_count.one: {count} of {max} — one colour gives a flat tint

gradient_strength_note: How much of the gradient shows through the app.
notifications_blocked_toast: Notifications are blocked by the browser
notifications_intro: These settings apply to this browser only. Per-guild and per-channel notification levels and mutes are in the guild and channel menus, and sync across your devices.
notifications_blocked_browser: Blocked in your browser's site settings.
play_sound_notifications: Play a sound for new notifications
dnd_note: Do Not Disturb mutes all notifications.
dm_privacy_everyone_hint: Anyone on the server can DM you directly.
dm_privacy_requests_hint: Friends go straight through. Anyone else can send one message that waits under Message requests.
dm_privacy_friends_hint: Only friends can DM you. Nobody else can start a conversation.
dm_privacy_note: Only friends can add you to group DMs, whatever you pick here.
local_options_intro: These settings live only in this browser/file and never sync to the server.
auto_update_checker_label: Automatically check GitHub for newer standalone releases on load
update_notifier_label: Show a toast when an update is found
local_options_note: This pings GitHub's public release API — no account data is sent. Turn it off if you'd rather not.
remove_avatar_body: You go back to a coloured circle with your initial.
remove_banner_body: The image is deleted from the server.
log_out_device_body: {device} will need to log in again.
touch_grass_hint: After about three hours of unbroken use, suggest going outside. It's a parody app; it's also good advice.
reminders_note: Set with /remind, kept on this device for this account. They only fire while Nightcord is open.
reminders_none: Nothing set. Try /remind 20m take the bins out.
